**DPS Midtjylland** is the regional psychiatric service operating within [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]]. It is highlighted in the ADHD database's annual reports as a central example of systemic registration challenges within the Danish psychiatric system, specifically due to a severe and notable drop in the number of registered assessment pathways [^src1] [^src2]. This decline in registered data makes it difficult to accurately measure treatment quality and is attributed to broader structural barriers identified in the reports, such as inadequate IT support, insufficient staffing resources, and fragmented patient pathways across different treatment providers [^src2].

As an organizational entity, DPS Midtjylland functions as a regional provider for [[aarhus-universitetshospital-psykiatrien|Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien]] [^src1]. Key personnel associated with the organization include [[simon-hjerrild|Simon Hjerrild]], who works as a Consultant, Clinical Lecturer, and PhD within the Team for ADHD, clinic 2, department of psychoses at the hospital and DPS Midtjylland [^src1] [^src2]. The significant drop in registered pathways at DPS Midtjylland underscores the ongoing difficulties in evaluating and maintaining treatment quality for children, youth, and adults with ADHD in the region [^src1] [^src2].
